T: The circle of trust has snacks.
D: A male nurse meets his girlfriend's intimidating ex-CIA father for a weekend that goes wrong at every turn.
P: Serve the mains when Greg is asked to say grace at dinner.
S: the pool volleyball game Greg takes too far

Corn chips piled with smoky chipotle chicken, black beans and melted cheddar, topped with pico de gallo, pickled jalapeno, guacamole and sour cream. Poach 400g chicken thighs for 20 minutes, shred and toss with 1 chopped chipotle in adobo and a splash of the sauce. Layer 300g corn chips with the chicken, a drained tin of black beans and 200g grated cheddar, and bake at 200C for 8 minutes. Dice 3 tomatoes, half a red onion and coriander with lime. Mash 2 avocados with lime and salt. Top with pico, jalapeno, guacamole and sour cream.
the cat who uses the toilet
Tuna mixed with mayo, celery, spring onion and lemon, spooned onto crisp cucumber rounds, finished with dill and black pepper.
Eggs boiled 10 minutes, yolks whipped with mayo, Dijon and a splash of pickle juice, piped back in, smoked paprika and chives on top.
M: Byrnes family roast sirloin and gravy
the dinner where Greg says grace

Sirloin roasted pink and carved thick, with crisp roast potatoes, honey buttered carrots and a rich red wine gravy. Season a 1.5kg sirloin roast the day before. Parboil 1kg potatoes for 8 minutes, rough them up and roast in oil at 220C for 50 minutes. Sear the beef, then roast at 200C to 52C inside, about 40 minutes, and rest 20 minutes. Boil 500g carrots and toss with butter and honey. Add 150ml red wine to the roasting tray and reduce, then add 300ml beef stock and 1 tbsp flour paste and simmer for gravy.
the rehearsal dinner for Pam's sister
Salmon fillets roasted at 200C for 10 minutes with a crust of dill, parsley, lemon zest and breadcrumbs, with herbed new potatoes and asparagus.
W: dessert, well away from the gazebo
Sweet pastry blind baked at 180C, filled with lemon juice, zest, eggs, sugar and cream whisked together, baked at 140C for 30 minutes until just set, chilled, icing sugar on top.
K: Greg reckons he can milk just about anything

Ice-cold full cream milk blended thick with vanilla ice cream and malt powder, poured into tall frosted glasses with whipped cream and a sprinkle of malt. Put four tall glasses in the freezer for 15 minutes. Blend 800ml ice-cold full cream milk, 8 scoops vanilla ice cream, 4 tbsp malted milk powder and 1 tsp vanilla extract until thick and frothy. Pour into the frosted glasses, top with whipped cream and dust with a little extra malt powder.

s.note: the cat who uses the toilet
s.how: Mix a 185g tin of tuna with 2 tbsp mayo, a finely diced celery stick, a spring onion and lemon juice. Spoon onto thick cucumber rounds and finish with dill and black pepper. Keep it away from the cat.
Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes and halve. Whip the yolks with 3 tbsp mayo, 1 tsp Dijon and a splash of pickle juice. Pipe back and finish with smoked paprika and chives.

m.note: the rehearsal dinner for Pam's sister
m.how: Mix 50g breadcrumbs with dill, parsley and lemon zest. Press onto 4 salmon fillets and roast at 200C for 10 minutes. Boil 800g new potatoes and toss with herbs. Steam 2 bunches asparagus.

w.note: dessert, well away from the gazebo
w.how: Blind-bake a tart tin lined with 2 sheets sweet shortcrust. Whisk the juice and zest of 4 lemons, 4 eggs, 150g sugar and 150ml cream. Pour in and bake at 140C for 30 minutes until just set. Chill and dust with icing sugar.

d.note: Greg reckons he can milk just about anything
d.how: Put four tall glasses in the freezer for 15 minutes. Blend 800ml ice-cold full cream milk, 8 scoops vanilla ice cream, 4 tbsp malted milk powder and 1 tsp vanilla extract until thick and frothy. Pour into the frosted glasses, top with whipped cream and dust with a little extra malt powder.
